capabilities: List tasks of the focused note, periodic notes or picked notes
Filter tasks by open, completed or cancelled status
Group tasks under their nearest heading
Toggle checkboxes in the panel and write the change back to the file
Jump to a task's line by clicking its row
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide task dashboard; each panel lists only the tasks of the notes its sources resolve to.
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.14.0 or later; settings from version 1.2 migrate automatically. Without the Tasks plugin it falls back to flipping [ ] to [x] itself.
problem: Tasks buried in long notes can only be seen and ticked off by scrolling through the note itself.

relations.evidence: When Tasks is installed, ticking a checkbox in the panel hands the toggle to that plugin
A periodic source follows another plugin's folder and name format by default

summary: Sidebar panels that list the checkboxes of the focused note, periodic notes or picked notes, with status filters and heading grouping.
